notes: ABST standard rate 17% since 1 Jan 2024 (Revenue (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 2023; the IRD FAQ showing 15% is obsolete). Bullion coded 17: the complete ABST Act was read, Schedules 4-5 in full - gold/jewellery appear nowhere. Silver 17/17. Duty null: the CARICOM CET gives HS 7108 only as a 0-5% band; applied rate unverified.
